reviewed_by: Codex focused review for complete provider tool receipts
reason: The Core change persists completed tool results without command artifacts, exposes authorized bounded output retrieval in graph-only and other provider chats, and sends compact receipts by default. Ninety collected Python tests cover receipt delivery and context, tool routing and reasoning, same-session output authorization, workspace output retrieval, and failures. The added regression proves a graph result is persisted and readable before its first compact replay.
exclusions: No UI or native source changed. Frontend and browser layout tests do not inspect model-facing request payloads, so they are excluded. Unrelated backend tests and full suites are excluded. An isolated real-Core provider-wire run will verify the actual model request; production deployment and physical-device browser acceptance are outside this branch change.
